title: pillowcase set
text: pillowcase set. Needed spare pillow cases for guest room sheets and these matched a set that only came with one pillow case for each pillow.  Argh.  Anyway.. they weren't a perfect match, but close enough.  And now I have enough for 2 cases per pillow - my preference.  They are soft... and microfiber like.  I'm sure they won't last forever, as a really nice 100% cotton pillowcase with a high thread count would.. but they haven't pilled or snagged... yet... I will update if new info seems useful. They came quickly (I have prime) and arrived in great condition along with other things I had ordered.
